'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Kevin Shannon LS Infiltration''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Infiltration / Unlikely Allies|VB8-L-infiltration-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
